2. The short fact leading to this Rule is that, the petitioner and his brother Mosadder Ali, who are wage-earners, purchased 4.00 acres of land appertaining to SS Plot No. 16, 316, 367, 368 and 370 of Khatian No. 20/2 from one Nirmala Chowdhury and Sundip Chowdhury by a registered kabala dated 30-7-1970 and since such purchase they are holding and possessing the said land. It has been also stated that since the petitioner and his brother were residing in the United Kingdom they could not mutate their names in the revenue records earlier and subsequently they mutated their names in respect of the aforesaid purchased land in Mutation Case No. 1518 of 1990 in the Office of the Assistant Commissioner. Land, Jagannathpur and got the mutated Khatian No. 34 in their names. It has been also stated that one Alkas Mia, who is inimical to the petitioner, made an application to the respondent No. 2 for cancellation of the Mutation. Case No. 1518 of 1990 on certain false allegation and though the respondent No. 2 did not have the jurisdiction to entertain such application, who became functus officio after allowing Mutation case and relief against the said order is available before the Assistant Commissioner by way of review or by an appeal to the Appellate Authority, entertained the said application of Alkas Mia and started Miscellaneous Case No. 32 of 1993-94 and passed an order on 18-9-1993 for issuance of notice upon the parties. The petitioner further asserted that although no notice was served upon him, the process server filed an incorrect report showing service return and on 25-9-1993 one Mastafar Ali filed an application praying for adjournment on behalf of the petitioner though the petitioner had no knowledge of any such application and adjournment was allowed by the respondent No. 2. Subsequently two dates were shown to have elapsed for filing objection by the petitioner though the petitioner had no such knowledge. The petitioner stated that he having learnt that the respondent No.2 had joined hands with his enemy filed an application before the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Sunamgonj and obtained an order of stay and the records of Miscellaneous Case No. 32 of 1993-94 of the Office of the respondent No. 2 was called for by order dated 16-10-1993 but in spite of the said order the respondent No. 2 most illegally recorded an order on 18-10-1993 in Miscellaneous Case No. 32 of 1993-94 modifying his previous order of mutation in favour of the petitioner and maintaining mutation of 0.8266 acres of land in the name of the petitioner and 4.13 acres of land out of 4.96 acres of land was ordered to be recorded in Khatian No. 1 treating the same as khas land of the Government. Photostat copy of the order sheet of the said Miscellaneous Case No. 32 of 1993-94 along with the petition has been annexed to this writ petition and marked Annexures 'C' and 'CI' respectively. 

 8. It appears from Annexure 'D' that the respondent No. 2 initiated the proceeding for eviction of the petitioner from plot No. 370 of khas khatian No. 1 on the prayer made by one Alkas Mia alleging that the petitioner was unauthorized constructing a pucca latrine on the khas land of the Government. It further appears that the respondent No.2 after initiation of the said proceeding issued the notice on the petitioner directing him to stop further proceedings with the construction of the latrine and asking him to show cause within 1-1-1994 why he should not be evicted from the aforesaid plot of land failing which legal action was ordered to be taken against the petitioner.
